keyFacts: Sepia remaps every pixel toward warm brown tones using a fixed 3×3 color matrix.
The intensity slider blends between the original photo (0%) and full sepia (100%).
Values above 255 are clamped, which is why bright areas go creamy white.
The effect is applied per pixel, so the original resolution is fully preserved.
The preview updates live as you drag the slider.

limitations: Sepia is a color style only — it cannot add real film grain or scratches.
The filter is fixed; you cannot tune the exact brown hue.
Very saturated originals may clip to flat warm areas at 100% intensity.
Animated GIFs are processed as a single still frame.
